items.title: Dermalogica AGE Bright Clearing Serum Review: 2.0% Salicylic Acid, How to Use It
items.lead: Dermalogica AGE Bright Clearing Serum: an active two-in-one serum that clears and helps prevent breakouts while reducing visible signs of skin aging.
items.hook: The Dermalogica AGE Bright Clearing Serum: what it does and how to use it.
facts: Active two-in-one serum that clears and helps prevent breakouts while reducing visible signs of skin aging (30 ml)
Salicylic acid 2.0%; niacinamide is second on the ingredient list, right after water
Niacinamide with white shiitake mushroom for a brighter, more even-looking skin tone
AGE Bright Complex works with the skin's natural microbiome; resurrection plant phytoactives hydrate and smooth
Apply a thin layer, allow to dry, use under moisturizer up to twice a day as needed
Sensitive skin: build up to daily use; sensitive to salicylic acid: patch test first or avoid

scenes.caption: AGE Bright Clearing Serum
scenes.say: Breakouts and the first signs of aging, both at once? In this review, we look at the Dermalogica AGE Bright Clearing Serum: what it is, what's in it, and how to use it. If you have adult breakouts, this one is worth knowing about.

scenes.caption: Two-in-one serum
scenes.say: It's an active two-in-one serum. It clears breakouts and helps prevent new ones, while reducing visible signs of skin aging. So it is made for skin dealing with two concerns at the same time: breakouts, and visible signs of aging.

scenes.caption: Salicylic acid 2.0%
scenes.say: The active ingredient is salicylic acid, at two point zero percent. Salicylic acid is the ingredient doing the breakout-clearing work in this serum, so it's the one to remember.

scenes.caption: Niacinamide
scenes.say: Next is niacinamide. It's second on the ingredient list, right after water. That means it's one of the main ingredients in the formula, not just a small extra.

scenes.caption: White shiitake mushroom
scenes.say: Niacinamide is paired with white shiitake mushroom, for a brighter, more even-looking skin tone. So while salicylic acid works on breakouts, this pairing works on tone.

scenes.caption: AGE Bright Complex
scenes.say: Then there's the AGE Bright Complex, which works with the skin's natural microbiome.

scenes.caption: Resurrection plant
scenes.say: And phytoactives from the resurrection plant help hydrate and smooth the skin. So the formula clears, brightens, and hydrates.

scenes.caption: 30 ml bottle
scenes.say: All of that comes in a thirty milliliter serum bottle.

scenes.caption: Thin layer, let it dry
scenes.say: Now, how to use it. After cleansing, apply a thin layer, and allow it to dry. A thin layer is all you need. Let it dry fully before the next step.

scenes.caption: Under your moisturizer
scenes.say: Then follow with your moisturizer. You can use it up to twice a day, as needed. It is a serum, so it goes on before your moisturizer, not after.

scenes.caption: Sensitive skin
scenes.say: If your skin is sensitive, build up to daily use. And if you're sensitive to salicylic acid, do a patch test first, or avoid it.

scenes.caption: Recap
scenes.say: So, the AGE Bright Clearing Serum: two point zero percent salicylic acid, niacinamide with white shiitake mushroom, and the AGE Bright Complex, in a thin layer under your moisturizer, up to twice a day. The link is in the description.

items.title: Dermalogica Intensive Moisture Balance: Moisturizer for Dry, Depleted Skin, How to Use It
items.lead: Dermalogica Intensive Moisture Balance: an ultra-nourishing moisturizer that restores lipid balance to dry, depleted skin, recommended for normal to dry skin.
items.hook: The Dermalogica Intensive Moisture Balance: what it does and how to use it.
facts: Ultra-nourishing moisturizer that restores lipid balance to dry, depleted skin
BioReplenish Complex of barrier lipids; prebiotic chlorella algae complex
Hyaluronic acid with echinacea, centella asiatica and aloe vera
After cleansing and toning, apply over face and neck in light, upward strokes, twice daily
Sizes: 15, 50, 100 and 150 ml; recommended for normal to dry skin

scenes.caption: Intensive Moisture Balance
scenes.say: Skin feeling dry and depleted, even after you moisturize? Today we're looking at the Dermalogica Intensive Moisture Balance: what it does, what's in it, and how to use it.

scenes.caption: Ultra-nourishing
scenes.say: Intensive Moisture Balance is an ultra-nourishing moisturizer. It's made to restore lipid balance to dry, depleted skin.

scenes.caption: Normal to dry skin
scenes.say: It's recommended for normal to dry skin, so it's for skin that feels dry, rather than skin that gets oily. If your skin needs more comfort and nourishment, this is the type of moisturizer it was made for.

scenes.caption: BioReplenish Complex
scenes.say: The first key ingredient is the BioReplenish Complex, a complex of barrier lipids. Barrier lipids are the lipids that help skin hold on to moisture, and here they help restore the lipid balance of dry, depleted skin.

scenes.caption: Prebiotic chlorella
scenes.say: Next is a prebiotic chlorella algae complex. Chlorella is an algae, used here as a prebiotic complex.

scenes.caption: Hyaluronic acid
scenes.say: There's also hyaluronic acid, the well-known hydrating ingredient. It works together with the barrier lipids in the formula.

scenes.caption: Echinacea, centella, aloe
scenes.say: Alongside it, you'll find echinacea, centella asiatica, and aloe vera. These botanicals round out the formula.

scenes.caption: Cleanse and tone first
scenes.say: Here's how to use it. Start with clean skin: cleanse first, then tone. Moisturizer is the last step of the routine.

scenes.caption: Light, upward strokes
scenes.say: Then apply Intensive Moisture Balance over your face and neck, in light, upward strokes. Cover your face and neck, and use light pressure rather than rubbing it in hard.

scenes.caption: Twice a day
scenes.say: Use it twice a day, morning and night, after cleansing and toning. Using it every morning and every night keeps your routine consistent.

scenes.caption: Four sizes
scenes.say: It comes in four sizes: fifteen, fifty, one hundred, and one hundred and fifty milliliters.

scenes.caption: Recap
scenes.say: To recap: Intensive Moisture Balance brings together barrier lipids, a prebiotic chlorella algae complex, and hyaluronic acid, to restore lipid balance to dry, depleted skin. The link is in the description.
